A Teacher's Day

Meet Daniel — he teaches Russian in England. Words about school, his day and his pupils' questions. Grammar: he teaches · Do you…? Does he…? Шаг за шагом — от упражнения к речи.

Daniel's day

10 min

a Meet Daniel. He is a teacher of Russian — like you, but in England! Listen once. Does he like his job?Это Дэниел — учитель русского, как вы, только в Англии. Послушайте. Ему нравится его работа?

Daniel: «My working day»Listen first · Если быстро — нажмите 🐢
  1. Daniel:Hi, I'm Daniel. I'm a teacher. I teach Russian at a big school in Manchester. My pupils are aged eleven to sixteen.
  2. Daniel:I get up at half past six and I have breakfast with my wife, Lucy. She's a doctor, so she leaves home very early.
  3. Daniel:I go to school by bike. My lessons start at nine. I teach five lessons a day.
  4. Daniel:At break I have a coffee in the staff room and talk to my colleagues.
  5. Daniel:After lessons I check homework and prepare lessons for the next day. I don't give a lot of tests — my pupils don't like them!
  6. Daniel:I get home at about six. In the evening I cook dinner, and sometimes I watch Russian films.
  7. Daniel:I love my job, but I'm always tired on Fridays!

Does Daniel like his job?

b Listen again. Complete the facts about Daniel.Послушайте ещё раз и допишите.

  1. He teaches at a school in Manchester.
  2. He gets up at half past .
  3. He goes to school by .
  4. He teaches lessons a day.
  5. He gets home at about .

d Look: Daniel says I teach, but we say he teaches. Why? That's the grammar of the next stage.Дэниел говорит I teach, а мы о нём — he teaches. Почему? Это грамматика следующего этапа.

present simple: he / she

15 min

a Read the four steps. Press 🔊 and repeat. All the examples are about Daniel.Прочитайте четыре шага. Нажмите 🔊 и повторите. Все примеры — про Дэниела.

Grammar Easy · Грамматика без страхаhe / she + -s
1
Одна мысль

Когда говорим о нём или о ней (he, she, it, Daniel, my wife), к глаголу добавляем -s. I teach → he teaches. А «не» для него/неё — doesn't, и тогда -s уже не нужно: he doesn't teach.

2
Формула-конструктор
I+teach+Russian.
He+teaches+Russian.

+s: gets, starts · +es (после s, sh, ch, x, o): teaches, watches, goes, does · y → ies: studies · have → has

I+don't+give+tests.
She+doesn't+give+tests.
3
Смотри, как это работает · нажми 🔊
  • Daniel teaches Russian.
  • He goes to school by bike.
  • He has a coffee at break.
  • His wife works in a hospital.
  • He doesn't give a lot of tests.
4
Осторожно!
❌ He teach Russian. → ✅ He teaches Russian.
он / она → -s
❌ She don't work. → ✅ She doesn't work.
он / она → doesn't
❌ He doesn't teaches. → ✅ He doesn't teach.
после doesn't — без -s

b Step 1. Daniel → he. Daniel says «I…». You tell his story: «He…».Шаг 1. Дэниел говорит «I…», вы рассказываете о нём: «He…».

  1. «I get up at half past six.» → He up at half past six.
  2. «I teach five lessons a day.» → He five lessons a day.
  3. «I go to school by bike.» → He to school by bike.
  4. «I have a coffee at break.» → He a coffee at break.
  5. «I check homework after lessons.» → He homework after lessons.
  6. «I don't give a lot of tests.» → He a lot of tests.

c Step 2. Spelling. Write the verb with he / she.Шаг 2. Напишите глагол для he / she.

  1. teach → she
  2. watch → she
  3. go → she
  4. study → she
  5. have → she
  6. prepare → she
  7. do → she
  8. explain → she

d Step 3. Don't or doesn't?Шаг 3. don't или doesn't?

  1. Daniel speak Russian at home.
  2. I work on Sundays.
  3. His pupils like tests.
  4. Lucy teach. She's a doctor.
  5. We have lessons in August.
  6. My cat like music.

e Step 4. Lucy's day. Write the verb. Careful: + or −?Шаг 4. День Люси (жены Дэниела). Напишите глагол.

  1. Lucy (work) in a hospital.
  2. She (leave) home at seven.
  3. She (not / teach).
  4. She (finish) work at eight in the evening.
  5. She (not / speak) Russian.
  6. She (love) blini!

Questions for Mr Jones

8 min

a Daniel's pupils interview him for the school blog. Listen. What is the funny question at the end?Ученики берут у Дэниела интервью. Послушайте. Какой вопрос в конце — смешной?

Interview: «Our Russian teacher»Use 🐢 if it's fast · Текст — в конце
  1. Pupil:Mr Jones, do you speak Russian at home?
  2. Daniel:No, I don't. My wife doesn't speak Russian. But I read Russian books every evening.
  3. Pupil:Does your wife like Russian food?
  4. Daniel:Yes, she does! She loves blini.
  5. Pupil:Do you give a lot of homework?
  6. Daniel:No, I don't. Just a little, but every day.
  7. Pupil:What time do you get up?
  8. Daniel:At half past six. Every day!
  9. Pupil:Does your cat speak Russian?
  10. Daniel:Ha-ha! No, it doesn't. But it likes Russian music!

The funny question is about…

c Open the transcript. Find the questions. They start with Do or Does. When do we use Does? That's the next grammar.Откройте текст. Вопросы начинаются с Do или Does. Когда Does? Это следующая грамматика.

questions: Do / Does

12 min

a Read the four steps. Press 🔊 and repeat the questions from the interview.Прочитайте четыре шага. Повторите вопросы из интервью.

Grammar Easy · Грамматика без страхаDo you…? Does he…?
1
Одна мысль

В вопросе в начало ставим помощника: Do (I, you, we, they) или Does (he, she, it). Глагол — без -s: Does he teach? Короткий ответ повторяет помощника: Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.

2
Формула-конструктор
Do+you+give+homework?
Does+he+give+homework?

Ответ: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. · Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't. — не просто «Yes».

What time+do+you+get up?
Where+does+she+work?
3
Смотри, как это работает · нажми 🔊
  • Do you speak Russian at home?
  • Does your wife like Russian food? — Yes, she does.
  • What time do you get up?
  • Does your cat speak Russian? — No, it doesn't.
4
Осторожно!
❌ Does he teaches? → ✅ Does he teach?
после does — без -s
❌ You like tests? → ✅ Do you like tests?
в начале — Do
❌ Do she work? → ✅ Does she work?
she → Does

present simple or continuous?

12 min

a Read the rule. The examples are from Daniel's message.Правило — на примерах Дэниела.

Grammar Bank🎃present simple · present continuous
Grammar Easy · Грамматика без страхаevery year… / right now…
1
Одна мысль

Обычно, всегда, каждый год → present simple: we have, he teaches. Сейчас, сегодня, в этом году (временно) → present continuous: they are carving.

2
Формула-конструктор
Every year+we+have+a party.
Right now+they+are carving+pumpkins.

always, usually, every year → do / does · now, today, this year → am / is / are + -ing

3
Смотри, как это работает · нажми 🔊

  • This year our head teacher is wearing a witch costume.
4
Осторожно!
❌ Every year we are having a party. → ✅ Every year we have a party.
Каждый год → present simple.
❌ Look! They carve pumpkins. → ✅ Look! They are carving pumpkins.
Сейчас → -ing.
❌ He teach Russian. → ✅ He teaches Russian.
he / she → -s.

a Read the four steps. Press 🔊 and repeat. All the examples are from Daniel's call.Прочитайте четыре шага. Нажмите 🔊 и повторите. Все примеры — из звонка Дэниела.

Grammar Easy · Грамматика без страхаam / is / are + -ing
1
Одна мысль

Когда что-то происходит сейчас или в эти дни (now, today, this week), говорим: am / is / are + глагол-ing. «Дэниел стоит у школы (прямо сейчас)» → Daniel is standing. «Не» — not: I'm not teaching. В вопросе am / is / are идёт вперёд: Are you teaching?

2
Формула-конструктор
I+'m+standing+in front of the school.
They+'re+having+a break.

I → am (I'm) · he / she / it → is (he's, it's) · we / you / they → are (we're, they're)
-ing: teach → teaching · have → having (без e) · swim → swimming, sit → sitting

He+isn't+teaching+this week.
Are+you+having+a good time?

Короткий ответ: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. · Yes, they are. / No, they aren't. · Yes, it is. (не «Yes, it's»)

3
Смотри, как это работает · нажми 🔊

  • The boys are playing football.
  • The girls are taking photos.
  • Daniel is staying in a small hotel.
  • He isn't teaching this week.
4
Осторожно!
❌ I standing. → ✅ I'm standing.
нужен помощник am / is / are
❌ She is play football. → ✅ She is playing football.
нужно -ing
❌ You are having a good time? → ✅ Are you having a good time?
в вопросе are — вперёд

Daniel's blog

a Daniel writes a blog for his school website. Read it. What is it about?Дэниел пишет блог для сайта своей школы. Прочитайте: о чём он?

Our week in St Petersburg

Hello from St Petersburg! This week ten of our pupils and I are visiting our partner school, and we're having a wonderful time.

At home in Manchester, I get up at half past six and go to school by bike. I teach five lessons a day, and I check homework every evening. But this week is different! I'm not teaching, and I'm not checking homework. I'm staying in a small hotel, and I'm walking to school — no bike!

Our pupils are staying with Russian host families. They're practising their Russian all day, and they're learning a lot. At this school, lessons start at half past eight, and the pupils stand up when a teacher comes in. Our pupils love it!

Right now I'm sitting in the staff room and writing this blog. My Russian colleagues are drinking tea and talking about the timetable. It's raining again, but we don't mind!

See you next week! — Mr Jones

usually or now?

a Read the four steps. Press 🔊 and repeat. The examples are from Daniel's blog.Прочитайте четыре шага. Повторите примеры из блога Дэниела.

Grammar Easy · Грамматика без страхаI teach or I'm teaching?
1
Одна мысль

Две «коробки». Обычно, всегда, каждый день → present simple: Daniel teaches five lessons a day. Сейчас, сегодня, на этой неделе → present continuous: This week he isn't teaching. Слова-подсказки помогают выбрать!

2
Формула-конструктор
He+teaches+Russian+every day.
This week+he+'s visiting+a partner school.

I teach: usually, always, often, never, every day, on Mondays
I'm teaching: now, right now, today, this week, at the moment, Look!

Do+you+teach+on Saturdays?
Are+you+teaching+this week?

Глаголы-«чувства» — без -ing: like, love, want, know. The pupils love it! (не are loving)

3
Смотри, как это работает · нажми 🔊
  • Daniel usually goes to school by bike.
  • This week he's walking to school.
  • He checks homework every evening.
  • This week he isn't checking homework!
  • The pupils love St Petersburg.
4
Осторожно!
❌ I'm teaching Russian every day. → ✅ I teach Russian every day.
every day → present simple
❌ Look! It rains. → ✅ Look! It's raining.
сейчас → am / is / are + -ing
❌ I'm loving St Petersburg. → ✅ I love St Petersburg.
love, like, want, know — без -ing

The School Trip

Last Friday Daniel took his class to the science museum. The bus was late, a boy got lost, and the robot show was amazing! School-trip words, Daniel's story and a letter — and the past simple the easy way: was / were, visited, didn't, Did you…?

“Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.”Benjamin Franklin

  1. Kate, a teacher:Hi Daniel! How was the trip to the science museum on Friday?
  2. Daniel:Oh, it was crazy but great! First, the coach was late — we waited for forty minutes in the rain.
  3. Kate, a teacher:Oh no! Were the children OK?
  4. Daniel:Yes, they were fine. They played games and sang songs. At the museum the guide was really funny, and the robot exhibition was amazing.
  5. Kate, a teacher:Did the children like it?
  6. Daniel:They loved it! They asked hundreds of questions. Then we had our packed lunches in the park.
  7. Kate, a teacher:Any problems?
  8. Daniel:One! Little Max got lost in the gift shop. I didn't see him for ten minutes. I was so scared!
  9. Kate, a teacher:Where was he?
  10. Daniel:Behind a big dinosaur, with a robot toy! In the evening I was very tired, but it was a lovely day.

a Read the steps. Press 🔊 and repeat. The examples are from Daniel's story.Прочитайте шаги, слушайте и повторяйте.

Grammar Bank1Cwas / were and the past simple -ed
Grammar Easy · Грамматика без страхаwas / were · visited, waited
1
Одна мысль

Прошлое → was / were: I / he / she / it was, we / you / they were. Нет → wasn't / weren't. Вопрос → Was it…? Were they…? Обычные глаголы в прошлом + -ed: wait → waited, play → played, love → loved. Форма одна для всех!

2
Формула-конструктор
The coach+was+late.
The children+were+fine.
We+waited+for forty minutes.
They+played+games.

I / he / she / it → was · we / you / they → were · глагол + -ed

3
Смотри, как это работает · нажми 🔊
  • The coach was late.
  • The children were fine.
  • We waited for forty minutes.
  • They played games.
4
Осторожно!
❌ The children was fine. → ✅ The children were fine.
they → were.
❌ We wait for forty minutes yesterday. → ✅ We waited for forty minutes yesterday.
Прошлое → -ed.
❌ It were amazing. → ✅ It was amazing.
it → was.

A thank-you letter from Max (8)a letter · about 100 words

Dear Mr Daniel, thank you for the trip to the museum! I liked the robots most. The big blue robot talked to me and danced!

I didn't like the coach — it was very late and it was cold. But we sang songs, and that was fun.

I'm sorry I got lost. I didn't want to go away. I saw the robot toy and I wanted to look at it. Did you look for me for a long time?

Mum says thank you too. She didn't go on a school trip when she was a girl. Can we go to the zoo next time? Love, Max

Grammar Bank1Cpast simple ➖ ❓: didn't / Did…? + irregular verbs
Grammar Easy · Грамматика без страхаdidn't · Did you…? · went, saw, had, took
1
Одна мысль

Нет → didn't + глагол без -ed: I didn't like the coach. Вопрос → Did you + глагол? Did you look for me? — Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. Неправильные глаголы запоминаем: go → went, see → saw, have → had, take → took, get → got.

2
Формула-конструктор
I+didn't+like+the coach.
Did+you+look+for me?
We+went+to the museum.
Max+saw+a robot toy.

did / didn't + глагол без -ed · went, saw, had, took, got — неправильные

3
Смотри, как это работает · нажми 🔊
  • I didn't like the coach.
  • Did you look for me?
  • We went to the museum.
  • Max saw a robot toy.
4
Осторожно!
❌ I didn't liked it. → ✅ I didn't like it.
После didn't — без -ed.
❌ Did you saw the robots? → ✅ Did you see the robots?
После Did — обычный глагол.
❌ We goed to the museum. → ✅ We went to the museum.
go → went.

Sam's perfect weekend

a Sam sends you a voice message about his weekend. Listen once: where is he right now?Сэм прислал голосовое о выходных. Где он сейчас?

A voice message from SamListen twice · Use 🐢 if it's fast · Text at the end
  1. Sam:Hi! It's Sam. Guess what? It's my perfect weekend!
  2. Sam:Every Saturday I wake up late, at about ten. I have breakfast with my sister — we usually cook pancakes.
  3. Sam:Right now I'm sitting in the park. It isn't rainy today, so I'm going for a long walk.
  4. Sam:Yesterday I called my grandma and we talked for an hour.
  5. Sam:My hobby is photography, so I'm taking lots of photos. What are you doing this weekend? Call me!

Where is Sam right now?

Three Unusual Cafés

20 min

a Read about three unusual cafés. Which one would you like to visit?Три необычных кафе. В какое вы бы пошли?

Three Unusual Cafés

a magazine page

In the Book Café you can drink tea and read books. There are books on every wall — about two thousand! You can take a book home if you bring another book.

The Cat Café is very popular with children. There are eight cats there. They sleep on the chairs, and you can play with them. But you can't bring your dog!

The Upside-Down Café is the strangest. The tables and chairs are on the ceiling! The food is normal, but everybody takes photos. It's open every day from nine to six.

What is the text about?

b True, false or not in the text?Верно, неверно или в тексте этого нет?

There are about 2,000 books in the Book Café.

You can take a book home without bringing one.

There are ten cats in the Cat Café.

You can bring your dog to the Cat Café.

The Upside-Down Café is open every day.

The Book Café sells cakes.

  3. the most unusual (para 3) →

  1. Which café would you like to visit? Why?
  2. Is there an unusual café in your town?

present simple · continuous · past simple

20 min
Remember · Запомнитеpresent simple · continuous · past simple
Every day+I wake up+at seven.
Now+I'm sitting+in the park.
Yesterday+I called+my grandma.

every day → present simple · now → am / is / are + -ing · yesterday → past simple (-ed / went, had…)

a Every day, now or yesterday? Tap the group.Каждый день, сейчас или вчера?

Every dayNowYesterday
  1. I wake up at seven.
  2. Look! She is cooking pancakes.
  3. We went to the park.
  4. He calls his grandma on Sundays.
  5. They are sitting in a café.
  6. I called my friend.
  7. Sam is taking photos.
  8. She has breakfast at eight.

b Right or wrong? Quick-fire!Верно или ошибка? Быстрый тест!

Look! It is raining.

Yesterday we go to the cinema.

She doesn't like cats.

Did you call your grandma?

He cook every Sunday.

Usually (present simple)Now (present continuous)
